data.one_liner: A customizable dropdown filter menu widget for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides customizable dropdown headers and menu items that can display any widget. Allows controlling the show/hide states via a controller.
use_when: You need to build e-commerce style filter menus like Meituan or Taobao.
You want a fully customized dropdown menu content and animation.
avoid_when: You are looking for a simple standard form DropdownButton.
You need native dropdown components inside a CustomScrollView or NestedScrollView without a Stack.
strengths: Highly customizable header and menu widgets.
Supports custom animations and mask colors.
weaknesses: Currently restricted to being used inside a Stack.
Does not natively support CustomScrollView or NestedScrollView yet.
data.minimal_example:
GZXDropDownHeader(
  items: [
    GZXDropDownHeaderItem('Menu Item'),
  ],
  stackKey: _stackKey,
  controller: _dropdownMenuController,
)
